permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Fetches the guest card, answers a floor associate's spoken questions about stock, size and price, and looks up a photographed product tag or part. All requests go to cuesea's own service.

permissions.name: camera
permissions.desc: Photographs a product tag or a broken part with the phone camera, so the answer can appear in the glasses. It photographs things, never people: CueSea does no face detection and no person matching, and the photo is used once and not stored.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: A double press opens the microphone so an associate can ask a question hands-free while helping a customer. The mic closes itself when they stop speaking.
